sql:
SELECT p.ProductName, sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHand, sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyStock, sum(i.OnHandQuantity) - sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS Gap
FROM retail.FactInventory i
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
) latest ON i.StoreKey = latest.StoreKey AND i.ProductKey = latest.ProductKey AND i.DateKey = latest.max_date
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY p.ProductName
ORDER BY Gap DESC
LIMIT 10
